description: SRCE Trame Verte Réservoirs is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. LOCATION: sde.crenvironment.srcetramevertereservoirs YEAR: 2014 --- FORMAT: vector --- DETAIL: Biodiversity reservoirs constituting the Regional Ecological Coherence Scheme (SRCE) in Languedoc-Roussillon. Layer provided in November 2014 by the DREAL LR under the name "NSRCERESERVOIRSR91". More metadata here Note: In order to identify the regional sub-trames, reference should be made to the field "MILMAJREG". Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "SRCE Trame Verte Tanks" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
